label: Event tents
title: Party Tent Rentals in Dallas–Fort Worth
description: Ask about a tent for your DFW backyard party, reception or outdoor event. Share the guest count, setup surface and event date for a site-specific quote.
intro: Tell us what needs to fit under the tent. A backyard lunch with seated guests needs a different layout than a reception with a buffet, DJ and dance space.
section: What goes into your tent quote?
details: Space at the venue
Send the approximate length and width of the open area, the surface underneath and a photo if you have one. Mention gates, steps or anything that affects delivery access.
What you want covered
Give us the seated guest count and tell us whether the food, music or ceremony area also needs cover. Include any tables or chairs you want quoted with the tent.
Time on site
Let us know when vendors can enter and when the venue needs the space cleared. We’ll confirm a suitable size, setup arrangements, availability and pricing with you.
prompt: Tell us the guest count, surface and space available.

label: DJ services
title: DJ Services for Dallas–Fort Worth Events
description: Request DJ availability for a DFW party, wedding or quinceañera. Share the venue, music preferences, announcements and hours you want covered.
intro: Need someone to play the music and keep your event on schedule? Tell us when guests arrive, when the music ends and which moments you want the DJ to handle.
section: Plan the music around your event
details: Playing time
A ceremony, dinner and dance floor can have different start times or even different locations. Include each one so the quote covers the hours and spaces you need.
Music and announcements
Tell us the music styles your guests like and whether you want introductions, a first dance, toasts or quinceañera entrances. Mention any language preference for announcements.
Venue details
Share the venue name, whether the DJ will be indoors or outdoors, vendor access hours and any sound cutoff. We’ll confirm the DJ, equipment and services included in your quote.
prompt: Tell us your event type, hours and any announcements.

label: Round tables
title: Round Table Rentals in Dallas–Fort Worth
description: Request round banquet tables for a DFW wedding, quinceañera or party. Get a quote for table size, quantity, chairs and delivery to your venue.
intro: Planning dinner seating around round tables? Send your guest count or the number of tables on your venue plan. Ray will confirm the available diameter and quantity for your date.
section: From a guest count to a table count
details: Seating layout
If your venue already has a floor plan, tell us how many rounds it allows. Otherwise, share your guest count, room size and how many people you’d like at each table.
Tables that do another job
A cake table, gift table or sweetheart table may need its own spot. List those separately so every table in your quote has a purpose.
Chairs and linens
Tell us whether you also need chairs. If you’re arranging linens, ask us to confirm the table diameter before you choose a cloth size.
prompt: Tell us the number of tables or guests and any preferred diameter.

label: White resin chairs
title: White Resin Chair Rentals in Dallas–Fort Worth
description: Ask Ray’s Rentals about white resin chairs for a DFW ceremony, reception or party. Confirm the chair style, quantity and delivery details for your event.
intro: Planning ceremony rows, dinner seating or both? Tell us where the chairs will go and how many guests need a seat. We’ll confirm the chair style, availability and price for your date.
section: Get the seating right for each part of the day
details: Ceremony rows
Start with the number of guests who need a seat. Tell us if you’re saving a front row for family or leaving extra space beside the aisle.
Reception seating
Share the number of tables and seats per table. If ceremony and dinner seating overlap, mention whether you want separate sets or plan to move the chairs between them.
Style and setup
If your venue requires a particular chair or you’re matching a photo, text it to Ray. Include any setup request and the venue’s delivery window in your inquiry.
prompt: Tell us the chair quantity and ceremony or reception layout.
